release_notes: Replaced the elevated tabletop and sidebar with a full-canvas 3D first-person workshop.
Added WASD movement, mouse look, sprinting, jumping, pointer capture, and F-key fullscreen.
Balls now drop vertically from an overhead pipe into a physical floor arena.
The floor well and platforms can be picked up, moved, placed, and rotated directly in-world.
Added a physical workshop for buying platforms, upgrades, sheet music, and controlling concerts.
Expanded scene tests to cover walking, overhead spawning, direct well manipulation, platform purchasing/placement, the workshop, fullscreen support, and sidebar removal.
Updated browser smoke coverage for first-person input, fullscreen telemetry, ball emission, and recording.
`npm test` and `npm run build` both exit successfully; the web export was generated. Local browser smoke execution was unavailable because the sandbox prohibits opening a localhost socket (`EPERM`).
